topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
subtopic: Reading Fee Disclosures and Account Statements
source_evidence: Review your confirmation and account statements to be sure you’re being charged correctly.
answer: When checking investment fees, review your account statements and trade confirmations to see what you were charged. Disclosures such as fee schedules can help you identify the fees that may apply. If a charge is unclear, ask your investment professional to explain or break it down for you.
